settingsSchema.label: Instagram
settingsSchema.description: Full https:// links. Shown in the footer when it has no social links of its own.

settingsSchema.label: Main language
settingsSchema.description: The language your store is written in.

settingsSchema.label: Other languages
settingsSchema.description: Language codes separated by commas, for example hi, ta, fr. Shoppers pick one in the footer; you add the text in the editor's Language menu. Text you haven't translated shows in the main language.

settingsSchema.label: Custom CSS
settingsSchema.description: Applies to the whole store. Up to 10000 characters; imports, fonts and non-https links aren't allowed.

settingsSchema.label: Card style
settingsSchema.description: The shape and look of every product card in the store. Quick add puts an Add button and quantity on cards of products with no options.

settingsSchema.label: Show star ratings
settingsSchema.description: Stars and the number of reviews under the name, for products with published reviews.

settingsSchema.label: Let shoppers compare products
settingsSchema.description: A Compare tick on every card. Up to four products dock in a tray at the bottom of the page and open side by side, with their specifications, on a compare page.
